# Goalserve

> > Goalserve provides comprehensive sports data feeds and live score APIs covering major leagues including NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, Champions League, and more in XML/JSON formats with betting odds integration.

Goalserve is a leading sports data API provider offering real-time scores, statistics, fixtures, and odds comparison across 20+ sports including football, basketball, tennis, golf, rugby, motorsports, and horse racing. Their APIs serve publishers, betting platforms, and sports applications with customizable subscription packages.

## Key Topics

- Live Scores API
- Sports Data Feeds
- Betting Odds Integration
- XML/JSON Data Formats
- NBA & NCAA Basketball
- MLB Baseball
- Champions League
- Tennis (ATP/WTA)
- Golf (PGA/LPGA)
- Horse Racing
- Odds Comparison
- Player Statistics
- Fantasy Sports Data
- Real-time Sports Data
- API Subscription Packages

## Major Sports APIs

- [NBA Data Feeds API | NBA Odds API Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/NBA-api/description): NBA & NCAA basketball API with live scores, fantasy stats & odds data
- [NBA Data Feeds API | NBA Odds API Packages](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/nba-api/prices): NBA & NCAA basketball API pricing for live scores, fixtures & odds
- [MLB Data Feeds API Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/MLB-api/description): MLB baseball API with live scores, fantasy stats & injury reports
- [Tennis API Data Feeds | Tennis Live Score API Coverage](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/tennis-api/coverage): ATP, WTA, Challenger & ITF tennis tournament coverage for live score API
- [Tennis API Data Feeds | Tennis Live Score API Packages](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/tennis-api/prices): Tennis API pricing packages for live scores, point-by-point & odds
- [Golf API Data Feeds Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/Golf-api/description): PGA, LPGA & European Tour golf API with live leaderboards & stats
- [Golf API Data Feeds Packages](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/golf-api/prices): PGA, LPGA & tour golf API subscription packages and pricing

## Betting & Odds APIs

- [Live Sports Data Feeds API | Odds Comparison API Coverage](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/odds-comparison-api/coverage): Odds comparison API covering EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga & Champions League
- [Horse Racing API Data Feeds Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/horse-racing-api/description): Horse Racing API features: live data, entries, odds for UK/USA races
- [Horse Racing API Data Feeds Coverage](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/horse-racing-api/coverage): UK & US horse racing coverage including Cheltenham and Kentucky Derby

## European & International Sports

- [Handball Data Feeds Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/handball-api/description): Handball API features covering live scores, odds & fixtures
- [Handball Data Feeds Coverage](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/handball-api/coverage): Handball API covering Bundesliga, Champions League & World Cup
- [Volleyball Data Feeds Coverage](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/volleyball-api/coverage): Volleyball API coverage including Bundesliga and World Cup tournaments
- [Rugby API Data Feeds Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/rugby-api/description): Rugby Union & League API covering Super Rugby, NRL & Super League
- [AFL Data Feeds API Description](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/afl-api/description): Australian Football League API with live scores and odds data
- [Motorsports API Coverage](https://www.goalserve.com/en/sport-data-feeds/motorsports-api/coverage): Motorsports API coverage with live data and betting odds integration
